title: Blast Wind
overview:
Strategic destruction vertical shooter: "Blast Wind" launches!

Refined algorithms
Detailed graphics
A level of polish that will satisfy even hardcore fans

A nuclear catastrophe has left only a handful of survivors, who rode out the fallout aboard the Ark. As they rebuild, Gorn, a machine society sealed beneath the Earth's crust, rises to attack. Fight back with ancient fighter craft unearthed by the new civilization.

Blast through six vertically scrolling stages, each ending in a boss battle. Fly into switches to open alternate routes with different enemy waves and boss patterns, or to release bonus items. Each ship carries a main shot and a weaker homing shot that seeks targets while you dodge.

- Two players fight together: the Hayate, piloted by Kyou, and the Reppu, piloted by Forn, each with its own weapons
- A second player can join at any time
- Four difficulty levels, adjustable ships and credits
- High scores and total play time are saved
